apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store URLs (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/name/id284882215) or numeric app IDs.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter storefront codes (us, gb, de, jp...). Use "top" for the 20 largest markets or "all" for every storefront (170+). Empty = the country in the app URL, else us.

maxReviewsPerCountry.title: Max reviews per country
maxReviewsPerCountry.description: Apple serves up to 500 of the most recent reviews per storefront.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Stop an app after this many reviews across all countries. Empty = no limit.

minRating.title: Min stars
minRating.description: Only reviews with at least this many stars.

maxRating.title: Max stars
maxRating.description: Only reviews with at most this many stars (e.g. 2 for complaints).

since.title: Since
since.description: Only reviews after this date: 2026-01-01, or relative like "7 days", "4 weeks", "3 months".

keyword.title: Keywords
keyword.description: Comma-separated; keep reviews whose title or text contains any of them (case-insensitive).
